Bacalaitos.d: Lacy salt cod fritters with garlic and fresh coriander.

Tostones.d: Green plantain fried twice, smashed flat, spooned with garlic and lime mojo.
Tostones.note: A taste of the old neighborhood.

Pernil.d: Garlic and oregano pork shoulder, roasted five hours to crackling. Rice with pigeon peas.
Pernil.note: Seven fifty. Every bit counts toward seventy-five.

Paradise flan.d: Coconut caramel custard, baked slow, turned out cold.

El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch.d: Dark rum, pineapple, fresh lime and spiced syrup, long over ice, nutmeg grated on top.
El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch.note: Poured under the Escape to Paradise poster.
